question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The blank no. 4 in the passage is meant to describe a specific characteristic or action.
 
• "Require" fits appropriately in the context, as it indicates the necessity or demand for something to happen.
 
• Other options ("Rectify," "Pacify," "Specify") do not align with the context of describing what is needed or demanded by the situation.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Rectify (सुधारना): "Rectify" means to correct something, which does not fit the context of describing what is needed.
 
• Pacify (शांत करना): "Pacify" means to calm or soothe, which does not align with the demand or necessity being described.
 
• Specify (निर्दिष्ट करना): "Specify" means to state explicitly, which is unrelated to the idea of necessity in this context.
